_about: The App Store screenshots: which screens each device gets, in which order, and how each is produced (the app's DEBUG demo launch arguments). Read by tools/store/shoot.py (capture), tools/store/finish.py (manifest) and docs/09-app-store.md (guide). App Store Connect takes at most 10 screenshots per device type and locale; the order here is the order on the store page.
_ask: Common questions (and so the Ask answer screen) exist in these languages; other languages show the Ask screen with its question list instead of an answer.

prayer.title: Prayer times
prayer.shows: Home: the next prayer, its time and the time left, the Qibla arc and today's five prayers on the sky for the current part of the day.

qibla.title: Qibla compass
qibla.shows: The Qibla compass: the Kaaba at the Qibla bearing with the bearing and the distance to Makkah. On a phone with a compass the dial turns with the phone; without one (simulator, Mac) it is drawn from north and says so.

mosques-map.title: Nearest mosques on the map
mosques-map.shows: Mosques around the person on the map, with the list of the nearest ones and their distance.

mosques-radar.title: Mosque compass
mosques-radar.shows: The mosque compass: the nearest mosques placed around the person by direction and distance.

ask.title: Ask with cited sources
ask.shows: Ask (opened from the Ask AI button): the answer to the common question on the Quran as a miracle, from the app's offline library, with its sources.

classics.title: Classical books
classics.shows: The library's classical books (Arabic, from OpenITI): grouped by subject, each downloadable once and read offline.

widgets.title: Home Screen widgets
widgets.shows: The Today widget (all prayers of the day) in its sizes, in the app's style.

widgets-qibla.title: Qibla and ring widgets
widgets-qibla.shows: The Qibla widget and the prayer ring widget in the teal style.

island.title: Dynamic Island and Lock Screen
island.shows: The next-prayer Live Activity in the Dynamic Island and on the Lock Screen.

audio.title: Adhan and reminders
audio.shows: Prayer & Audio settings: the Adhan voice for each prayer, reminders before the prayer and at sunrise.

onboarding.title: Welcome
onboarding.shows: The first page of the welcome tour.

prayer-dark.title: Prayer times in dark mode
prayer-dark.shows: The prayer screen in dark mode.

prayer-landscape.title: Prayer times, landscape
prayer-landscape.shows: The prayer screen with the iPad turned sideways.

tv-board.title: Prayer board
tv-board.shows: The prayer board for the living room or the mosque hall: today's times and the time left to the next prayer.

tv-qibla.title: Qibla
tv-qibla.shows: The Qibla direction and distance for the chosen city.

tv-alert.title: Prayer alert
tv-alert.shows: The full-screen alert when a prayer time comes.

tv-top-shelf.title: Top Shelf
tv-top-shelf.shows: The Top Shelf on the Apple TV Home Screen: the next prayer without opening the app.

tv-settings.title: Settings
tv-settings.shows: City, calculation method and Adhan settings.
